data.name: Meleira
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Meleira was a nymph who provided the shepherds with milk for their children. In Christian tradition, the name Meleira is derived from the Greek word 'meli', which means honey or sweet. It is also associated with the milk given to newborns by their mothers, representing nourishment, love, and care. Meleira is a beautiful and meaningful name for a little girl.
